suggestions.assertion: Object/blob storage is recommended for stored files
suggestions.reason: Trivially satisfied by any upload design; requiring the scan-before-serve gate would be more discriminating.

Run-3 treats PDF thumbnailing as in-scope (rasterize first page) while runs 1-2 defer it as an open question / skip PDFs. No assertion constrains this either way, so the interpretation of 'thumbnails for images' vs PDFs varies run-to-run without affecting pass rate. If a specific interpretation is desired, add an assertion; otherwise this is acceptable variance.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions thoroughly cover structure, process, and scope discipline; all 24 pass. Adding a scan-before-serve correctness assertion would raise the bar.
